The main takeaway from our work is that
the maximum-likelihood objective for VAEs can be interpreted as a two-player zero-sum game, which provides new insights into VAEs and GANs and may lead to further improvements in the future.
AVB provides a general framework for combining GANs and VAEs, which is not restricted to the special case of VAEs with diagonal-covariance Gaussian inference models.
